prior_record.name: Google African cloud region (Nairobi)
prior_record.note: First Google cloud region on the continent, targeted for 2028.

decisions.note: Removed unconfirmed Nairobi proposal from the active project register. Google states its first African region opened in Johannesburg on 2024-01-31. This does not establish a Nairobi project or its proposed 2028 opening.
Added the AI-tools comparison from p.41 with the city-survey scope. Methods on pp.9–10 limit interpretation; not national adoption.

The report labels ownership 75% on p.12, but its methodology describes selected urban/semi-urban smartphone users (pp.9–10). Withheld as a national ownership estimate until the sampling denominator and weights are clarified.
Primary report p.15 gives 88%, with a smartphone-user base of 9,944 for 2025. The rounded headline is not a share of all Nigerians. Kept as contextual evidence; no national ownership value inferred.
Company statement says USD300m financing target subject to agreements and approvals. Recorded separately from committed capital and project capex.

Open page read in full. The article attributes 'more than 23 million' Nigerians without meaningful internet access to unnamed industry figures and separately reports that the Federal Government's Project BRIDGE flags 'more than 33 million' as offline, without reconciling the two or defining 'meaningful access'; the summit's own theme refers to 'the next 25 million users'. No observation was recorded. Needed: the underlying NCC or Project BRIDGE dataset with its definition of access, reference date and geographic coverage.

Company press release read in full. Announces a Johannesburg colocation facility for the iGaming sector, said to be live in Q4 2026, with no capacity, investment, employment or site figure and no AI-specific workload described. Nothing comparable to a project register row could be recorded and no capacity may be inferred. Needed: a capacity or investment disclosure, or a dated operating confirmation, before it can be considered for the infrastructure register.
